description: Let LIE, LIE DOWN, and LIE ON BED reach Bedroom sleep and DRINK FROM reach the Kitchen sink. LIE DOWN uses FIND RMUNGBIT like LOOK DOWN; ZILF rejects LIE DOWN ON OBJECT as two prepositions.

<SYNTAX LIE DOWN = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX LIE ON OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>

<SYNTAX LIE = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX LIE DOWN OBJECT (FIND RMUNGBIT) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX LIE ON OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX DRINK FROM OBJECT (HELD CARRIED ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-DRINK-FROM>
